name_zh: 卡尔扎伊：阿富汗建国/部落联邦/美国盟友/选举政治/塔利班回归
name_en: Karzai: Afghanistan Independence/Tribal Federation/American Ally/Electoral Politics/Taliban Return
description_zh: 卡尔扎伊是阿富汗的长期领导人，1960-至今，他领导阿富汗赢得独立，建立了阿富汗国。卡尔扎伊推行了部落联邦制，尊重了阿富汗的部落传统。卡尔扎伊与美国建立了密切的同盟关系，但这也引发了国内争议。卡尔扎伊推行了选举政治，但这也引发了国内政治动荡。他的统治结束后，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
description_en: Karzai was a long-term Afghan leader from 1960 to the present, who led Afghanistan to win independence and establish the state of Afghanistan. Karzai implemented tribal federation systems, respecting Afghanistan's traditional tribal structures. Karzai established close alliances with the United States but this also sparked domestic controversy. Karzai implemented electoral politics but this also sparked domestic political turmoil. After his rule ended, Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.
reason_zh: 卡尔扎伊领导阿富汗赢得独立，但他的美国盟友政策引发了国内争议。他的选举政治导致国内政治动荡。他的部落联邦制虽然尊重了传统，但也引发了争议。他的统治结束后，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
reason_en: Karzai led Afghanistan to win independence but his American alliance policy sparked domestic controversy. His electoral politics led to domestic political turmoil. His tribal federation system, while respecting tradition, also sparked controversy. After his rule ended, Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.
steps_zh: 学习卡尔扎伊的领导艺术和外交策略，理解在独立后国家建设的必要性
研究阿富汗的部落联邦制和民族融合，掌握在多元文化环境下推行和谐的必要性
分析卡尔扎伊与美国的同盟关系，理解在国际环境下推行改革的必要性
探讨卡尔扎伊的选举政治和民主制度，理解在传统社会中推行现代化的挑战
总结卡尔扎伊的经验教训，阐述在独立后国家建设的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Karzai's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, understand the necessity of推行国家建设 in post-independence contexts
Study Afghanistan's tribal federation system and ethnic integration, master the necessity of promoting harmony in multicultural environments
Analyze Karzai's alliance with the United States, understand the necessity of推行改革 in the international context
Explore Karzai's electoral politics and democratic systems, understand the challenges of推行现代化 in traditional societies
Summarize Karzai's experiences and the challenges of推行国家建设 in post-independence contexts
expected_zh: 掌握卡尔扎伊的领导艺术和外交策略，熟悉阿富汗的部落联邦制和民族融合，理解与美国的同盟关系和选举政治的重要性，培养学生对在独立后国家建设的理解和认识。
expected_en: Master Karzai's leadership art and diplomatic strategies, be familiar with Afghanistan's tribal federation system and ethnic integration, understand the significance of the alliance with the United States and electoral politics, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of推行国家建设 in post-independence contexts.
case_zh: 2001年，卡尔扎伊领导阿富汗赢得独立，建立了阿富汗国。他推行了部落联邦制，尊重了阿富汗的部落传统。卡尔扎伊与美国建立了密切的同盟关系，但这也引发了国内争议。卡尔扎伊推行了选举政治，但这也引发了国内政治动荡。2009年，卡尔扎伊在政治动荡中下台，阿富汗陷入了政治动荡，塔利班重新掌权。
case_en: In 2001, Karzai led Afghanistan to win independence and establish the state of Afghanistan. He implemented a tribal federation system, respecting Afghanistan's traditional tribal structures. Karzai established close alliances with the United States but this also sparked domestic controversy. Karzai implemented electoral politics but this also sparked domestic political turmoil. In 2009, Karzai stepped down in the face of political turmoil, and Afghanistan descended into political turmoil and the Taliban returned to power.
cross_cultural_impact: Tribal federation model, American alliance, post-9/11 Afghanistan reconstruction
